name: Lazy Gooseneck Phone Holder with Clamp
shortDescription: Flexible gooseneck arm that clamps to beds and desks to hold your phone.
description: A flexible gooseneck arm with a strong clamp that attaches to bed frames, desks and shelves to hold your phone hands-free. Bend it to any angle for videos, calls and recipes.
highlights: Strong clamp for beds and desks
